model: Black Pear MXB-50 BACnet interface for Mitsubishi G-50A / GB-50A / AG-150
applies_to: Mitsubishi Electric City Multi groups (up to 50) and outdoor/BC units (up to 50) behind a G-50A, GB-50A or AG-150 central controller.
summary: Small BACnet IP box from Innon Energy (Black Pear range) that talks to a Mitsubishi G-50A, GB-50A or AG-150 over Ethernet and publishes up to 50 air-conditioning groups. Each group gets a block of 18 objects whose instance is 1 + the 3-digit group address + a 2-digit object number, with paired write (_w) and read (_r) objects. Object names start with the unit name typed into the configuration program.
notes: Instance formula: 1xxx01-1xxx18 per group, where xxx is the group address 001-050. The list shows group 001 (100101-100118); groups 002-050 repeat the same block.
Outdoor/BC unit error codes use 1yyy22 with yyy = unit address 051-100; the list shows address 051 (105122).
Object names start with nnn, the unit name entered in the configuration program. The manual names the OC/BC error code nnn_ECode, the same as the group error code.
Instances 1xxx19-1xxx21 are unused. The System Forced Off, M-Net comms and G-50 comms objects are described in the manual but have no instance number in its object list, so they are left out.

The operation mode state table numbers Heating as 11 again (after Bypass), so the heat-pump boiler modes run 11-15 there but 12-16 in the command table. Modes 9-11 are Lossnay only, 12-16 heat-pump boiler only.
Only the group master (lowest indoor unit address in the group) accepts commands; writes to slave addresses do nothing.

source.title: MXB-50 BACnet Interface for Mitsubishi Air-Conditioning - Installation and User Guide

integration.summary: Give the MXB-50 and the G-50 separate IP addresses on the same subnet, set the G-50 IP, device ID and unit names in the PC configuration program, then map each group's _w objects for control and _r objects for feedback. Only group master addresses accept commands.
integration.enable: No BACnet enable point is needed for group control. A normally closed contact on the Enable Link terminals drives the G-50 Forced-Off feature: when the contact opens, all units are switched off and remote controllers disabled. The unit ships with a wire link fitted.
setup: Factory defaults (reset level 2): IP 192.168.1.10, subnet 255.255.255.0, G-50 IP 192.168.1.1, device ID 10, device name Black Pear MXB-50, foreign device TTL 1800 s.
Device ID, device name and object names can only be set with the PC configuration program (RS232/RS485 or network).
The Ethernet port is 10Base-T half duplex with no auto-negotiation.
DIP switch A-1 (Auto-Detail) reports AutoHeat/AutoCool instead of plain Auto; A-2 (Preserve-Settings) keeps present values over a power cycle.
gotchas: Commands written to a slave unit address in a G-50 group are ignored; use the group's lowest address.
Set Sys_New_Setting_Compare (BV 100027) active if the BMS writes command values continuously, so only changed values go to the G-50.
The device has no segmentation and a 206-byte max APDU, so keep ReadPropertyMultiple requests small.

points.name: nnn_ECode
points.description: [OC/BC address 051] Outdoor/BC unit 4-digit error code, 8000 = no error

points.name: Sys_New_Setting_Compare
points.description: [System] Write only changed settings to the G-50
points.states: 0=Always write new values, 1=Write only if different
